c74object.name: el.quadpanin~
c74object.description:
el.quadpanin~ positions and pans a monophonic audio input within a two-dimensional quadraphonic plane using normalized Cartesian coordinates (X and Y ranging from 0.0 to 1.0). Gains for the four speaker corners are calculated using Euclidean distance attenuation relative to each speaker position: (0.0, 1.0) for Front Left, (1.0, 1.0) for Front Right, (1.0, 0.0) for Rear Right, and (0.0, 0.0) for Rear Left. Panning coordinates are modulated continuously at audio rate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal): Monophonic audio input signal to be panned.
Inlet 2 [Middle Inlet] (signal): Normalized X coordinate (0.0 = Left, 1.0 = Right).
Inlet 3 [Right Inlet] (signal): Normalized Y coordinate (0.0 = Rear, 1.0 = Front).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Front Left speaker output (corner at X=0.0, Y=1.0).
Outlet 2 (signal): Front Right speaker output (corner at X=1.0, Y=1.0).
Outlet 3 (signal): Rear Right speaker output (corner at X=1.0, Y=0.0).
Outlet 4 (signal): Rear Left speaker output (corner at X=0.0, Y=0.0).

inlet.description: Monophonic audio signal to be panned across the quadraphonic field.
Horizontal position in the quadraphonic plane (0.0 = Left, 1.0 = Right).
Vertical/depth position in the quadraphonic plane (0.0 = Rear, 1.0 = Front).

outlet.description: Output signal for the Front Left speaker (X=0.0, Y=1.0).
Output signal for the Front Right speaker (X=1.0, Y=1.0).
Output signal for the Rear Right speaker (X=1.0, Y=0.0).
Output signal for the Rear Left speaker (X=0.0, Y=0.0).

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be panned. Signals arriving at inlets 2 and 3 continuously modulate the X and Y coordinates (0.0 to 1.0) at audio rate.
